metadata.title: That 1 kill that felt like a glitch in Valorant’s matrix LOL
metadata.description:
Did I just hack the game or what?
My aim was definitely on break but hey, it landed!
Only in Valorant would this work out.
Click if your luck is bigger than your skill!

Watch till the end and question reality with me!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
